title: Cloud Platform Selection
transcript:
Platform Engineering Lead: Alright folks, let's dive into the cloud strategy options for the acquisition. First up, we have AWS Managed Services.

SRE: I don't think that's the best option for us. Losing critical control and flexibility for certain hospital-specific applications is a big concern.

CTO: Agreed. Next, there's the idea of building and maintaining a custom cloud platform.

Finance Partner: That's a non-starter. A 3-year development timeline would delay critical integration work during the acquisition process.

CTO: True, and Azure for all services is out due to long-term maintenance costs being too high for high-performance computing needs in medical imaging.

Platform Engineering Lead: Given these constraints, I propose a hybrid approach using AWS for select services and maintaining our existing on-premises infrastructure.

SRE: I like the idea of maintaining control and flexibility, but a hybrid approach may introduce complexity and potential security risks.

Finance Partner: (sighs) And I have reservations about the potential for unexpected costs during the transition.

CTO: Understood. However, a hybrid approach provides the fastest time-to-value while still offering a good fit for hospital-specific applications. AWS's vast service offerings and ability to integrate with our existing infrastructure make it the most practical solution.

Platform Engineering Lead: Furthermore, this approach aligns with the acquisition timeline and ensures that integration work can commence immediately.

Finance Partner: (reluctantly) Fine, but we need to be vigilant about additional costs during the transition phase to properly secure data and ensure seamless integration between AWS and the existing infrastructure.

CTO: Agreed. The success of this approach depends on effective management of multiple clouds and on-premises systems.

SRE: (looking at Platform Engineering Lead) You're taking the lead on this one?

Platform Engineering Lead: Yeah, I'll own it. But we all need to be involved in the management to make this work.

CTO: (nods) I sign off on this approach. Let's make it happen.

(Off-topic exchange)

SRE: By the way, any updates on the vending machine situation? I've been craving a good cup of coffee lately.

Finance Partner: I've got a lead on a local roaster that can set us up with a corporate account.

SRE: Perfect! Just what I needed to hear. Back to work!
document: Hospital Group opts for a hybrid approach, leveraging AWS for selected services while retaining existing on-premises infrastructure. The decision rejects AWS Managed Services due to concerns over loss of control and flexibility for specific hospital applications. A custom cloud platform development, with an estimated 3-year timeline, was deemed delaying critical integration work during the acquisition process. The hybrid approach ensures the fastest time-to-value, catering to hospital-specific applications while aligning with the acquisition timeline. The success of this approach hinges on effective management of multiple cloud and on-premises systems. Platform Engineering Lead.
